mgmt_bio.text: Olivier Le Peuch has been chief executive officer of SLB since August 2019, leading the company's global strategy, operations and long-term vision while also serving on its board of directors. A French national, he joined the company, then known as Schlumberger, in 1987 as an electrical engineer, became chief operating officer in February 2019 and succeeded Paal Kibsgaard as CEO on 1 August 2019. His earlier executive roles included executive vice president of Reservoir and Infrastructure, president of the Cameron Group, president of Completions, vice president of Engineering, Manufacturing and Sustaining, and president of Schlumberger Information Solutions. He holds an electrical engineering degree from Bordeaux Engineering School and a research master's degree in microelectronics from the University of Bordeaux.

citations.title: SLB Seals ChampionX Takeover

sentences.quote: Schlumberger Ltd./NV (SLB) said Wednesday it had completed the acquisition of ChampionX Corp.
sentences.text: SLB (formerly Schlumberger Limited) completed its all-stock acquisition of ChampionX on July 16, 2025, adding production chemicals plus artificial lift, digital and emissions technologies, with roughly $400 million of annual pretax synergies targeted within three years.
Management frames production and recovery as a less cyclical, growing market aligned with its returns-focused, capital-light strategy.

Digital is the margin engine, with fourth-quarter 2025 revenue of $825 million, up 25% year on year at a 34.0% pretax operating margin, and digital annualized recurring revenue surpassed $1 billion by the end of 2025.
International markets, about 80% of revenue, give broad geographic diversification, with offshore-led growth in Latin America, Europe and Africa and Asia offsetting Middle East disruptions.
